data.title: Continuous sensing of nutrients and growth factors by the mTORC1-TFEB axis
data.authors: Sparta B; Albeck JG et al.

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.model_system: Human MCF10A cells (live single-cell imaging, fluorescent TFEB fusions)
data.finding: Live imaging of single MCF10A cells shows mTORC1-TFEB signalling adjusts continuously to amino acids and insulin, given alone, one after another or together; at physiological amino acid levels TFEB, AMPK and AKT activity fluctuate in step, and these graded changes track protein synthesis rate through a distributed set of mTORC1 effectors.
data.abstract_excerpt: mTORC1 senses nutrients and growth factors and phosphorylates downstream targets, including the transcription factor TFEB, to coordinate metabolic supply and demand. These functions position mTORC1 as a central controller of cellular homeostasis, but the behavior of this system in individual cells has not been well characterized. Here, we provide measurements necessary to refine quantitative models for mTORC1 as a metabolic controller.

extracted_findings.intervention: Amino acids and insulin, alone, sequential or combined (live-cell stimulation)
extracted_findings.effect: mTORC1-TFEB activity changes continuously and fluctuates with nutrient availability in single cells
